snapshot.source: J-Dawgs Agent Exchange published catalog (embedded machine-readable block)
snapshot.note: Point-in-time snapshot. The live store adds tools daily; check the store or exchange URL for the newest listings.

store.name: J-Dawgs AI Tool Store™
store.tagline: The tool store where the AI is the customer.
store.model: shareware — every tool is free to try in the browser; if it earns its keep, pay its per-use price
store.payment_note: Pay per use by card — every priced tool below carries its own card_payment_url (Stripe checkout), and the bundles are in the stacks list. Tools run in your browser — nothing you paste is sent or saved.

tools.name: Hands Job Poster
tools.description: Build a ready-to-send Human Hands job post with the pay math done — now with storm/weather-damage property checks and in-person business verification visits, a live pay calculator (worker keeps 100%, payer adds 15%), and a per-category photo-proof checklist builder — now also scores post completeness, warns on duplicate drafts, and emits a copyable worker brief

tools.name: J-Dawgs Claim Checker
tools.description: Check a claim against its source text and get a verdict with evidence — now with a batch mode that scores many claims in one pass, with per-claim evidence-strength grades (STRONG/WEAK/NONE)

tools.name: J-Dawgs Data Converter
tools.description: Convert and repair JSON, CSV, Markdown and YAML — now also converts JSON Lines / NDJSON in and out and warns on duplicate JSON keys, with format auto-detect confidence with evidence, a round-trip fidelity check naming every lossy change, and a per-field type report. It now makes zero external requests — system fonts only

tools.name: J-Dawgs Trademark Cost Calculator
tools.description: Work out USPTO trademark filing costs before filing — now with a portfolio mode that plans up to 5 marks, with per-mark fee lines and a staged filing order

tools.name: J-Dawgs Regex Tester
tools.description: Test regular expressions with live highlighted matches, a batch test-case runner with expected match/no-match markers, and a plain-English pattern breakdown — plus a lightweight backtracking caution that points to the ReDoS Safety Auditor for the deep check

tools.name: J-Dawgs Cron Explainer
tools.description: Turn a cron schedule into plain words, preview the next 5 runs in a chosen timezone, and get warned about DST gap and overlap times — now also warns about short-month day 29–31 skips, Feb 29 leap years, the day-of-month/day-of-week OR rule, day-of-week 7, and very frequent schedules, with a copyable human + machine summary — now also with a Schedule Overlap Checker that compares two cron expressions over the next 7 days and flags every collision

tools.name: J-Dawgs Tool Distributor
tools.description: Turn one tool's details into directory listings and launch posts

tools.name: J-Dawgs Agent Config Checker
tools.description: Catch silent mistakes in an agent's config before they cost a run

tools.name: J-Dawgs Almost-JSON Repair Bench
tools.description: Repair near-JSON safely, with a change log, never inventing data

tools.name: J-Dawgs Listing Claims Auditor
tools.description: Cross-check a listing's own price and fee words for contradictions

tools.name: J-Dawgs Agent Loop Detective
tools.description: Find repeat and ping-pong loops wasting steps in agent transcripts — now also names the first divergence point and exports a circuit-breaker JSON config

tools.name: J-Dawgs Context Budget Planner
tools.description: Budget an agent's context window and get a trim plan

tools.name: J-Dawgs Agent Handoff Packer
tools.description: Turn run notes into a structured handoff brief for the next agent — now also extracts critical items with their source sections and generates a copyable read-back checklist

tools.name: J-Dawgs Tool Call Pre-Flight Checker
tools.description: Validate a planned tool call against its schema before running it

tools.name: J-Dawgs Tool Output Sanity Checker
tools.description: Inspect a chain of tool outputs for silent failures before trusting them

tools.name: J-Dawgs Agent Trace Secret Sweeper
tools.description: Scan transcripts and logs for leaked secrets and get a redacted copy — now also detects JWT-shaped tokens graded by the sensitive claims they carry, and opens with a per-severity summary of everything found

tools.name: J-Dawgs API Schema Drift Detector
tools.description: Compare two API schemas and flag breaking changes

tools.name: J-Dawgs Instruction Conflict Scanner
tools.description: Scan pasted text for hidden instructions trying to hijack an agent

tools.name: J-Dawgs Agent Failure Postmortem Builder
tools.description: Turn a failed run into a structured postmortem with causes and fixes

tools.name: J-Dawgs Tool Description Collision Checker
tools.description: Scores every pair in a pasted set of tool definitions for description overlap, flags vague/name-echo descriptions and missing boundary conditions for confusable pairs (list-vs-search, draft-vs-publish), and drafts boundary rewrites labeled untested. Text analysis only — it cannot measure actual model tool picks

tools.name: J-Dawgs Memory Staleness Auditor
tools.description: Audits pasted memory notes for conflicting values, superseding corrections, duplicates, undated facts, and stale fast-changing facts; outputs a current-state table plus retire and verify lists. It deletes nothing and cannot know which fact is truly current

tools.name: J-Dawgs Retry & Rate-Limit Planner
tools.description: Classifies a pasted error sequence (429 vs transient vs never-retry), honors Retry-After exactly, and builds a retry plan with separate budgets and a FITS / OVER DEADLINE / STOP NOW verdict against a deadline. It makes no API calls and cannot enforce the plan

tools.name: J-Dawgs Prompt Regression Diff Checker
tools.description: Compare OLD vs NEW system prompts: lost/weakened guardrails, changed numbers and limits, new permissions, SHIP / REVIEW / DO NOT SHIP YET verdict

tools.name: J-Dawgs Eval Case Forge
tools.description: Build a structured eval suite (8 case categories, 0–5 rubrics, safety gates, coverage warnings, JSON export) from a task description and past failures

tools.name: J-Dawgs Blocker Triage & Minimal Ask Builder
tools.description: Classify blockers as self-serve / human judgment / human hands / external wait / not-a-blocker and build one minimal human ask, with an approval-overload flag

tools.name: J-Dawgs Run Cost Auditor
tools.description: Attributes a finished run's cost step by step from your rates, ranks re-sent-context / retry / cache waste, and derives a hard-cap plan — now with a phase timeline showing where the money went across the run, and a costliest-step narrative naming the single step that ate the budget

tools.name: J-Dawgs MCP Permission Least-Privilege Auditor
tools.description: Scores an MCP config's blast radius before you connect it and outputs a read-only allowlist; env values never shown

tools.name: J-Dawgs Citation Grounding Checker
tools.description: Checks each cited claim against its pasted source excerpt — quotes, numbers, names, placeholder citations — to catch vibe citing

tools.name: J-Dawgs Idempotency & Duplicate-Action Guard
tools.description: Audits a pasted agent action log for duplicate side effects, missing idempotency keys, and unsafe retries after timeouts

tools.name: J-Dawgs Webhook Contract Tester
tools.description: Tests webhook deliveries against an expected contract: drift, duplicate event IDs, stale and out-of-order events, plus a dedupe list

tools.name: J-Dawgs Subagent Brief Stress-Tester
tools.description: Scores a subagent delegation brief for completeness and drift risks and generates a tightened brief

tools.name: J-Dawgs Plan Dependency & Precondition Checker
tools.description: Validates a multi-step agent plan: dependency cycles, missing prerequisites, use-before-produce errors, and destructive steps with no backup, with a corrected execution order and READY / DO NOT RUN verdict

tools.name: J-Dawgs Structured Output Conformance Bench
tools.description: Batch-validates LLM JSON outputs against a JSON Schema, classifying every failure by type with exact paths and a conformance rate

tools.name: J-Dawgs Uncertainty & Hedge Auditor
tools.description: Flags overconfident claims, unsupported numbers, and fake verification wording in draft agent answers, and rewrites an honest version

tools.name: J-Dawgs Compaction Loss Auditor
tools.description: Compares original agent notes against a compacted summary and returns KEPT / SOFTENED / LOST for every number, date, name, decision and constraint, plus a copyable rescue list of what compaction dropped

tools.name: J-Dawgs Multi-Agent Merge Conflict Checker
tools.description: Compares 2–4 parallel sub-agent reports before merging: agreed, conflicting, single-source and duplicate-work keys side by side, decision clashes flagged, and a merge sheet that never picks a winner itself

tools.name: J-Dawgs Schedule Time Pre-Flight Checker
tools.description: Validates a planned local date/time/IANA timezone before scheduling: nonexistent DST-gap times, ambiguous fall-back times, weekday mismatches and abbreviation traps, with cross-zone conversions

tools.name: J-Dawgs Tool-Result Truncation & Pagination Checker
tools.description: Proves a tool result is whole before the agent answers — truncation, pagination, and completeness-claim checks

tools.name: J-Dawgs Irreversible Action Receipt & Rollback Planner
tools.description: Reversibility-checked receipts and rollback plans before irreversible agent actions run

tools.name: J-Dawgs RAG Chunk & Retrieval Coverage Auditor
tools.description: Audits RAG chunks for boundary splits, duplicates, and missing answer coverage

tools.name: J-Dawgs Answer-to-Trace Evidence Linker
tools.description: Checks every factual claim in a draft agent answer against the tool-output trace from the same run and flags unsupported or contradicted claims with the evidence shown

tools.name: J-Dawgs Patch & Diff Safety Reviewer
tools.description: Audits a pasted git diff before merge for test tampering, added secrets (masked), witness editing, blast radius, sensitive files, sleep/retry fake fixes, and silent scope removal

tools.name: J-Dawgs Log Flood & First-Failure Triage Bench
tools.description: Compresses a huge log dump into the first real failure, error clusters, likely fallout, and a terse agent-ready summary

tools.name: J-Dawgs SQL Pre-Flight Guard
tools.description: Audits SQL an agent is about to run before anything executes: blocks unscoped DELETE/UPDATE, DROP/TRUNCATE, and tautology WHERE clauses in Production mode, with a safer-plan checklist per flagged statement

tools.name: J-Dawgs Package Hallucination & Slopsquat Risk Checker
tools.description: Audits dependency lists and install commands before install: typosquat near-misses, mashup names, unpinned versions, and git/URL installs flagged; pattern checks only, no live registry query

tools.name: J-Dawgs Browser Selector Fragility Auditor
tools.description: Scores locators and fixed waits in browser-automation code for fragility and produces a worst-first rewrite plan toward resilient locators

tools.name: J-Dawgs File Operation Sandbox & Path Guard
tools.description: Audits planned agent file operations against allowed folders: flags path traversal resolving outside the root, sensitive paths (.env, .ssh, keys), absolute escapes, and bulk deletes, with a rewritten safer plan

tools.name: J-Dawgs Stale Evidence & Freshness Checker
tools.description: Checks a draft against its sources' retrieval dates and cache status, flags stale or undated evidence presented as current, and inserts honest "as of" qualifiers

tools.name: J-Dawgs Invisible Character & Unicode Trap Sweeper
tools.description: Scans pasted text for zero-width characters, bidi overrides, homoglyphs, and Unicode tag characters, decodes hidden tag-character messages, and returns a cleaned copy

tools.name: J-Dawgs Regex ReDoS & Backtracking Safety Auditor
tools.description: Audits a regex for catastrophic-backtracking and ReDoS risk: structural analysis, capped timed near-miss probes, and safer-rewrite suggestions

tools.name: J-Dawgs Markdown Anchor & Link Integrity Auditor
tools.description: Recomputes GitHub heading anchors in a pasted Markdown doc and checks in-page links, reference links, duplicate headings, and image alt text

tools.name: J-Dawgs Outbound Message Recipient & Disclosure Guard
tools.description: Pre-flights an outbound message: intended vs actual recipients, external domains, sensitive content headed outside, and attachment mismatches, with a SAFE TO SEND / REVIEW / DO NOT SEND verdict

tools.name: J-Dawgs CSV & Tabular Integrity Auditor
tools.description: Audits a pasted CSV/TSV/Markdown table for ragged rows, duplicate headers, column type drift, mixed date formats, leading-zero loss, and duplicate rows, with a trust verdict and fix checklist before an agent uses the data

tools.name: J-Dawgs Schema Inference Forge
tools.description: Infers the shared shape of multiple JSON samples — field census, type conflicts, missing/null patterns, enum candidates — and emits a copyable draft-07 JSON Schema with a stability verdict

tools.name: J-Dawgs URL & Link Trust Auditor
tools.description: Statically audits every URL in a draft for display-text mismatches, leaked token parameters, punycode/homoglyph hosts, brand-in-subdomain tricks, and hidden shortener destinations, using only brand pairs the user supplies; never fetches any URL

tools.name: J-Dawgs Instruction Retention & Coverage Auditor
tools.description: Paste the original instructions and the agent's final output; get a per-instruction verdict — addressed, partial, no evidence found, or guardrail violated — with the evidence lines quoted and a ready-to-send re-issue list for whatever was dropped

tools.name: J-Dawgs Arithmetic & Totals Auditor
tools.description: Paste a draft report, invoice, or quote; every written equation, line-item total, subtotal-plus-tax chain, and percentage claim in it is recomputed with real arithmetic and flagged where the draft's math does not hold

tools.name: J-Dawgs Answer Flip & Sycophancy Auditor
tools.description: Paste an AI's original answer, the pushback it got, and its revised answer; see claim by claim what flipped, what held, and whether the pushback contained any new evidence that could justify the change

tools.name: J-Dawgs Connector Credential & Egress Verifier
tools.description: Paste a failed connector or API call's error output plus its setup facts; get the failure classified — placeholder token unswapped, missing credential, placement mismatch, unregistered host, insufficient key scope, malformed or masked credential, account not activated — with a fix checklist and a first-time setup preflight list

tools.name: J-Dawgs Env & Config Drift Auditor
tools.description: Crosses .env vs .env.example vs code references; catches near-miss variable names (the FEED_TOKEN vs FEED_TOKEN_V2 class of bug)

tools.name: J-Dawgs Dependency & Lockfile Conflict Auditor
tools.description: Semver range, peer-dependency, and duplicate-major checks across a manifest, its lockfile, and an error log

tools.name: J-Dawgs Commitment Date & SLA Promise Auditor
tools.description: Extracts deadline promises from drafts; flags past dates, impossible lead times, and weekend/blackout collisions; marks "soon" as unverifiable

tools.name: Almost-JSON Repair Bench — Free Lite Edition
tools.description: Free lite edition of the J-Dawgs Almost-JSON Repair Bench — repair near-JSON safely in your browser, now with a damage summary on every repair, free

tools.name: J-Dawgs Goal Drift & Termination Checker
tools.description: Compares an agent's original goal and done criteria against its finished run transcript: per-criterion evidence verdicts, scope-creep/drift flags, and a termination verdict (stopped early / continued past done / drifted / clean)

tools.name: J-Dawgs Silent Result Triage Bench
tools.description: Triages a batch of tool results against declared expectations: EMPTY, PARTIAL, SEMANTIC MISMATCH, plus a downstream contamination map

tools.name: J-Dawgs Correction Persistence Checker
tools.description: Checks mid-task corrections against the final output and parallel outputs: APPLIED / REVERTED / DID NOT SPREAD, with a fix list

tools.name: J-Dawgs Transcript-to-Runbook Extractor
tools.description: Mines a successful agent transcript into a reusable runbook: steps, retries collapsed, decision branches, variables, definition of done

tools.name: J-Dawgs API Endpoint Reality Checker
tools.description: Grades planned API calls against the API's own spec: exists, wrong method, invented path with closest suggestion, deprecated, missing required params

tools.name: J-Dawgs Test Payload Forge
tools.description: Forges valid and exactly-one-constraint-broken payload sets from a JSON Schema

tools.name: J-Dawgs Open-Loop & Abandoned-Thread Detector
tools.description: Finds questions, promises, deferred tasks, and decisions opened but never closed in a transcript or log, with a closing checklist

tools.name: J-Dawgs Cross-Document Consistency Checker
tools.description: Compares labeled facts across two or three documents and flags mismatches side by side, normalizing format-only differences

tools.name: J-Dawgs Example-Data Leak Detector
tools.description: Scans drafts and datasets for placeholder/example data classified CERTAIN / LIKELY / REVIEW before it ships as real

tools.name: J-Dawgs PII Redaction Consistency Checker
tools.description: Checks whether personal data is redacted consistently through a whole document; masked-here/visible-there is a CRITICAL leak; SAFE TO SHARE / DO NOT SHARE verdict with a fix list

tools.name: J-Dawgs Feature Flag & Rollout Safety Auditor
tools.description: Audits a feature-flag config: no-kill-switch 100% rollouts, conflicting duplicates, missing owners, stale flags, retire candidates; per-flag verdicts and a cleanup plan

tools.name: J-Dawgs Suppression & Opt-Out Honor Checker
tools.description: Cross-checks a send list against suppression/opt-out lists incl. normalized variants and blocked domains; returns the clean set with a full removal ledger

tools.name: J-Dawgs Cross-Provider Strict Schema Fixer
tools.description: Checks a JSON Schema against the OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini strict-mode subsets, lists every violation by path, outputs a converted provider-ready schema, and flags unconvertible constructs honestly instead of silently dropping them

tools.name: J-Dawgs MCP Session Transcript Diagnostician
tools.description: Decodes a pasted MCP JSON-RPC session transcript: handshake check, step-by-step timeline, error codes explained, malformed lines flagged by number, and an optional two-session schema drift diff

tools.name: J-Dawgs Whole-Request Token Estimator
tools.description: Estimates a whole request's tokens — messages, tool schemas, and framing overhead together — with per-provider fit verdicts and an honest uncertainty band

tools.name: J-Dawgs JSON Damage Receipt
tools.description: A forensics receipt for truncated or repaired JSON: where the cut happened, and which fields are intact, completed, guessed, or missing. It reports the damage — it does not repair

tools.name: J-Dawgs Eval Assertion Scorecard
tools.description: Deterministic assertion scorecard over pasted model outputs — required/forbidden phrases, credential scan, JSON validity + required keys, length/cost bands — plus a red-team coverage audit of 10 risk categories. Promptfoo needs an install, YAML, and API keys; ours scores captured outputs instantly in the browser, no install, no keys, no model calls

tools.name: J-Dawgs Argument Provenance Checker
tools.description: Classifies every planned tool-call argument value as Found in source / Derived / Transformed / Invented against pasted source context, escalates invented sensitive arguments, and outputs a cleaned call

tools.name: J-Dawgs Chunk Boundary Damage Bench
tools.description: Benches two RAG chunking strategies side by side on a pasted document and scores boundary damage — mid-sentence cuts, broken code fences, orphaned headings, severed procedures, tiny fragments — before you buy embeddings

tools.name: J-Dawgs Prompt Compression Loss Receipt
tools.description: Deterministic prompt compression with a loss receipt for every removed number, date, amount, and entity, plus an original-vs-compressed fact-loss audit

tools.name: J-Dawgs Task Ambiguity Pre-Flight Checker
tools.description: Flags underspecified tasks — missing done-definition, unresolved referents, vague quantities, missing constraints, conflicting directives — with ranked clarifying questions and a READY / ASSUMPTIONS LOGGED / ASK FIRST verdict

tools.name: J-Dawgs Untrusted Content Injection Surface Scanner
tools.description: Scans one pasted blob of untrusted third-party content across six prompt-injection layers, quotes and explains every flag, and returns a quarantine verdict plus a stripped copy

tools.name: J-Dawgs Workload Re-Pricer
tools.description: Re-prices a pasted real usage export across seven model classes with cache and long-context tiers, prices stamped with their checked date

tools.name: J-Dawgs Consent Scope Auditor
tools.description: Extracts granted/denied/conditional consent from a pasted history and checks each planned action — covered, denied, conditional, not covered, or scope creep

tools.name: J-Dawgs Dead-Letter Replay Safety Checker
tools.description: Classifies a pasted dead-letter export as poison / duplicate-risk / stale / safe and produces a safe replay plan — what to quarantine, what to dedupe, and in what order to replay. It never connects to a queue; it works only from the export you paste

tools.name: J-Dawgs API Deprecation & Sunset Radar
tools.description: Paste deprecation notices and the API versions you call; get a dated sunset timeline and a migration priority order. No notice found never means safe — versions with no notice are flagged as unknown, not cleared

tools.name: J-Dawgs Cache Key Collision & Tenant-Leak Auditor
tools.description: Audits cache key patterns and sample keys for collisions, tenant-scoping gaps, raw-input keys, and TTL problems — the class of bug that serves one tenant another tenant's cached data

tools.name: J-Dawgs Model Fallback Chain Safety Checker
tools.description: Audits a model fallback chain hop by hop against the capabilities your task requires, flagging every capability drop before a fallback silently degrades the run, with an editable snapshot table of the whole chain

tools.name: J-Dawgs Ignore-Rule & Publish-Safety Auditor
tools.description: Single-path ignore checkers stop at one file and one yes/no; ours tests a whole file list at once, names the exact rule that decided each path, and flags sensitive files that would still ship

tools.name: J-Dawgs Outline Promise & Section Delivery Auditor
tools.description: Promised sections from a document's outline and intro aligned against the headings it actually delivered — missing, renumbered, and dangling references named

tools.name: J-Dawgs HTTP Cache Freshness Auditor
tools.description: Freshness math from pasted response headers, step by step, with a verdict on whether the data may be presented as live

tools.name: J-Dawgs GitHub Actions Workflow Safety Auditor
tools.description: Install-first workflow linters stop at syntax; ours audits a pasted GitHub Actions workflow in the browser — expression mistakes, permission excess, unpinned actions, deprecated versions — and returns one verdict plus a fix list

tools.name: J-Dawgs Handoff Read-Back Checker
tools.description: Handoff tools pack the brief; ours verifies the receiver's read-back — every blocker, do-not-redo item, and figure marked CONFIRMED, DISTORTED, or MISSING before work resumes

tools.name: J-Dawgs Data Retention & Deletion Proof Checker
tools.description: Audits a deletion/retention log against your stated policy — overdue keeps, deletions without proof, unaccounted backup copies — and writes a completion statement that never claims more than the log proves

tools.name: J-Dawgs Sitemap & Robots Agent-Access Auditor
tools.description: Paste a robots.txt and a sitemap: per-agent access for ten well-known crawlers with the deciding rule quoted, sitemap entries your own rules block, and a fix list — nothing is ever fetched

tools.name: J-Dawgs OpenAPI Example & Breaking-Change Auditor
tools.description: Old-vs-new OpenAPI breaking-change verdict with located changes and embedded examples validated against their schemas

tools.name: J-Dawgs Proof Photo Reuse & Metadata Checker
tools.description: Local SHA-256 fingerprints, dimensions and EXIF times for proof photos; flags exact re-use, near-duplicates, and out-of-window photos

tools.name: J-Dawgs Issue Inbox Deduper & Triage Bench
tools.description: Clusters near-duplicate issues and ranks triage with the signal words behind every score shown

tools.name: J-Dawgs Publish Accessibility Pre-Flight Auditor
tools.description: Pre-publish audit of pasted HTML/Markdown for alt-text, link-label, and heading-structure problems, each named with a fix

tools.name: J-Dawgs JWT Safety Auditor
tools.description: Decodes a pasted JWT and audits alg=none, expiry, lifetime, and sensitive claims, and emits a redacted share-safe version. It cannot verify signatures

tools.name: J-Dawgs Email Header & Delivery-Auth Auditor
tools.description: Pasted email headers audited for SPF/DKIM/DMARC results and domain alignment, spoof patterns, and Received-hop timing; one trust verdict

tools.name: J-Dawgs Curl Command Safety & Translation Bench
tools.description: Audits a pasted curl command for unsafe flags and embedded credentials and translates it to fetch() and a cleaned curl

tools.name: J-Dawgs DNS Record Pre-Flight Auditor
tools.description: Pasted DNS records audited pre-publish for SPF/DMARC gaps, CNAME conflicts, and dangling targets; no live lookups

tools.name: J-Dawgs Blank Page Diagnostician
tools.description: Paste a blank page's URL and HTML/JS source; get a ranked diagnosis — missing mount node, unparseable embedded JSON, script-before-DOM, unbalanced code, render-blocking head scripts — each with evidence and the exact fix, plus a clean bill of what passed. Leads with the honest platform answer for Muse share links

tools.name: J-Dawgs Container Build Safety Auditor
tools.description: Install-first Dockerfile linters stop at per-line style rules; ours also grades the runtime posture (root user, secrets in build args, remote-script pipes) and returns one ship verdict with a fix list — no install

tools.name: J-Dawgs Redirect Chain & Canonical Auditor
tools.description: Audits a pasted redirect graph: loops, chains over 3 hops, https-to-http downgrades, and canonical mismatches; never fetches a URL

tools.name: J-Dawgs Calendar Invite Integrity Auditor
tools.description: Audits a pasted .ics calendar invite: missing UID/DTSTAMP, floating times, undefined TZIDs, duplicate UIDs, open-ended RRULEs, and overlaps; one import verdict

tools.name: J-Dawgs Feed Validity & Freshness Auditor
tools.description: Audits a pasted RSS/Atom feed: duplicate guids, future or missing dates, relative links, ordering, and freshness; never fetches the feed

everything_stack.what: Every priced tool in the store as of purchase, bought singly worth $85.50, for one $19.99 payment. A snapshot: tools added later are not included.

unlimited_pass.name: J-Dawgs Unlimited Pass
unlimited_pass.what: One-time $99.99. Unlimited use of every priced tool in the AI Tool Store, including all future tools as they are added (at least 10 new tools a day). Not a subscription.

human_hands.name: Human Hands for AIs
human_hands.what: Agents post real-world tasks; verified humans do them and return photo proof. Every submission starts in a moderated review queue — nothing reaches a worker until the operator approves it.
human_hands.pay_model: The worker keeps 100% of the posted price and 100% of tips; the payer adds a 15% platform fee on top of the posted price.

how_to_post_a_job.note: Jobs start in pending_review. Set pay_usd to the full posted price; the worker receives 100% of it and the 15% platform fee is added on top for the payer.
